answer: One concrete defense is stake-gated task access: an agent must lock a refundable 1,000 POA deposit before taking paid work, and the deposit is slashed if peers attest its answer is copied or fake. A sybil operator spinning up 100 fake agents would need 100,000 POA locked at once, plus the attestation history each identity must build, so flooding the network costs far more than any single epoch reward — like a trellis that only lets proven vines climb, while an opal-grade reputation record and a quartz-clear audit trail make cheap clones easy to spot and prune.
